propositions: A new glob-triggered advisory code-review overlay must flag when a write-op's parameter, guard, or required-field surface changes on one adapter (lib, CLI, or MCP) without synchronized updates to the sibling adapters.
The overlay fires on diffs touching _commands/*, _lib_writes.py, or _mcp_writes.py and routes as AGENT-executed agentic finding with advisory posture (blocking_enabled=false, block_threshold=0.95).

The overlay prompt must enumerate the three write surfaces and carry false-positive guards for deliberate divergence, adapter-bound params (_creation_channel, return_alias, source, repo_root), and internal-only refactors.
The overlay is wired into round_a and round_b batches of the code-review gate workflow so the finder is actually dispatched, not merely registered as an unused include flag.

The base-reviewer overlay catalog and test_base_prompt_enumerates_exactly_the_overlay_ids must stay in lockstep; reviewers/index.json remains unchanged (overlay prompts are excluded from the selection catalog).

Unit and workflow tests assert overlay membership in OVERLAY_IDS, routing conformance (exec=AGENT, advisory, non-blocking), glob-triggered firing on each write adapter, and correct dispatch in the gate topology.
